extracted.intended_audience: general readers and artists seeking information about artist residencies (Yaddo)
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic overview of the Yaddo artist colony: its mission, history, facilities, disciplines supported, notable alumni, and aspects of its residency environment. Useful for artists considering residencies or researchers of artist communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission statement (nurture the creative process)
rubrics_metrics.description: Yaddo's mission is "to nurture the creative process by providing an opportunity for artists to work without interruption in a supportive environment."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This frames the institution's purpose and the type of experience it aims to provide: focused, uninterrupted creative time in a supportive setting. Applicants and evaluators can use this as a criterion to judge fit—work that benefits from concentrated, solitary development aligns with Yaddo's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disciplines accepted for residencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Yaddo "offers residencies to artists working in choreography, film, literature, musical composition, painting, performance art, photography, printmaking, sculpture, and video."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This list identifies eligible artistic fields; applicants should belong to one of these disciplines (or make a clear case of relevance). Use this as an eligibility/fit criterion when assessing whether a proposed project matches Yaddo's stated areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residency environment: uninterrupted, supportive, secluded facilities and gardens
rubrics_metrics.description: Yaddo is located on a 400-acre estate and aims to provide artists "an opportunity for artists to work without interruption in a supportive environment." While visitors are not admitted to the main mansion or artists' residences, they may visit the gardens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key residency features include physical seclusion, private living/working spaces, and access to gardens and estate facilities. This implies expectations for applicants about solitude and on-site conduct (limited public/visitor access) and suggests the kind of working conditions Yaddo maintains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track record and prestige (alumni achievements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Collectively, artists who have worked at Yaddo have won numerous awards (e.g., 82 Pulitzer Prizes, 34 MacArthur Fellowships, 70 National Book Awards, a Nobel Prize) and include many notable writers, composers, and artists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The extensive list of distinguished alumni functions as an implicit quality/performance metric for the institution: it signals prestige and the community's historical role in nurturing successful careers. Prospective applicants may infer high selectivity and reputation from this record.
